title: nasturtium draba
intro: Nasturtium draba, commonly known as Draba nasturtium-aquatica, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is a succulent, perennial plant with numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Draba nasturtium-aquatica include its analgesic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
